correctness.rationale: Exact piecewise Feynman–Kac backward problem with u-delta jump at x=a gives the full three-variable transform for D,r,a>0 and nonnegative Laplace parameters. Boundary and normalizations are explicit. The positive Lévy measure integrates to the conditional subordinator exponent; mixed differentiation gives mean, variance and monotone correlation. Five sparse finite-difference parameter checks, symbolic derivatives, marginal recovery and three Lévy integral checks corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: Completion time, local exposure at the reset site, and upper residence time are naturally co-measured first-passage quantities in the motivating study; their marginal laws do not determine joint trajectory dependence. The explicit triple transform and exponential-stopped-subordinator law evaluate that missing dependence, including a strict reset-rate correlation transition from zero to unity. This is a natural complete joint problem, not a gratuitous slice or numerical recalculation.
